observations: Two large upright forms dominate the center and right, outlined in black with interiors filled by overlapping vertical streaks of yellow, green, blue, magenta, and orange against a flat pink background.

A smaller fragmented cluster in the upper left includes a rectangular frame, a wedge of white zigzag lines, and small red circular marks that also recur on the right-side form, where they appear near a rounded upper shape and an elongated lower projection that can be read as a head and snout.
A loose grid of thin yellow and pink lines crosses the pink background, and a gray shadow falls beneath each major form, giving them weight on an otherwise flat plane.
reading: Two blocky upright forms stand side by side, their surfaces layered with competing vertical color streaks that read as both structure and noise. On the right form, paired red oval marks sit near a rounded upper mass and an elongated lower shape — a configuration that invites a figure or face reading without resolving it firmly. Gray shadows anchor each form to an implied ground while the background grid keeps the image from settling into depth.
contextAngle: Within the owned nnotb subset, this work sits between title neighbors nnxyz nnotb #34 and nnxyz nnotb #36, with title and recorded creation order aligned. Neither neighbor shares the pink background or block-form language.

connections.reason: Both works build solid-looking forms from dense overlapping colored lines, with paired red oval marks placed near the upper portion of the main form in a configuration that supports a face reading, though nifty faces #43 uses a blue field and resolves that reading more completely.

lookingQuestion: Do the red oval marks on the right form sit symmetrically relative to the rounded upper shape, and how does that placement compare to the red marks visible in the upper-left cluster?
ambiguities: The upper-left cluster may read as a separate smaller form or as a fragment of the same scene; its spatial relationship to the two main forms is not resolved by the image alone.
nnxyz nnotb #36 was inspected but shares no strong formal connection with #35 beyond title adjacency and was omitted as a connection.
